profile.summary: Mohit21GoJs demonstrates a focused expertise in core JavaScript utility functions and functional programming patterns, primarily evidenced by contributions to the Lodash library. Their contributions are centered around improving and extending utility functions (`_.orderBy`, `_.get`), indicating strong familiarity with functional programming concepts such as immutability, pure functions, and higher-order functions. While there is no evidence of work with modern frontend frameworks (React, Vue, etc.) or backend development (Node.js, Express), their contributions suggest a solid understanding of JavaScript core APIs, ES6+ features, and utility-based development. The limited number of contributions (3 PRs) and lack of involvement in testing, TypeScript, or async programming indicate a junior-level proficiency with a specialization in utility libraries and functional programming.
